title: Dependent finite mixed Nash equilibria in Lean
abstract: A Lean-native formalization of finite mixed Nash equilibrium for games in which each player has its own finite, nonempty action type. The library defines dependent profiles and finite expected payoffs, proves support equalization and Dirac transport, establishes the closed/compact/convex mixed-profile geometry, and connects the normalized excess map to a checked product-of-simplices Brouwer theorem. It also proves the correspondence between ambient finite games with player-indexed legal action sets and dependent legal-action subtypes. This is a reusable formalization artifact, not a claim of new mathematics or priority.
